# Phase 5B.5: Valid PMR

## PMR protocol
- PMR_mean_absolute = mean paired Frobenius discrepancy / mean in-source MAE.
- PMR_median_absolute = median paired Frobenius discrepancy / median in-source MAE.
- Paired bootstrap 95% CI is computed on the discrepancy numerator; denominator is the observed in-source error.
- SPG (smallest protocol gap) = median discrepancy / (best valid in-source MAE + epsilon).
